introduction: South Dakota Housing helps renters find the appropriate assistance route. Voucher applications go to housing authorities; income-based apartment applications go to the property.
description: South Dakota Housing helps renters find the appropriate assistance route. Voucher applications go to housing authorities; income-based apartment applications go to the propert

sections.who: Income, household size, location and property or program rules determine eligibility. Ask the specific provider about its selection criteria.
sections.get: Options include rent subsidies and apartments with limited rents. These arrangements have different rules and do not all provide an individual voucher.
sections.docs:

  • Contact details and any urgent housing notice.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the route

    Use SD Housing’s provider and property links.

  2. Contact local intake

    Ask the housing authority about vouchers or the landlord about the apartment’s program.

  3. Submit the provider’s application

    Confirm available units or waiting lists and save the application details.
sections.after: Keep provider contact information current and respond to any eligibility review or waiting-list update.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Rental programs and application pathways, Property and program eligibility. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does SD Housing process most applications?
Its page says it does not process applications directly for most rental-assistance programs.
Is a lower-rent apartment always a voucher?
No. The state distinguishes rental assistance from programs that limit the rent charged.
What if I do not know where to start?
SD Housing recommends 211 for local resource guidance.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
